import ctypes

# Load the libraries in the correct order
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the strtol function prototype
strtol = gsl.strtol
strtol.argtypes = [ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_char_p), ctypes.c_int]
strtol.restype = ctypes.c_long

# Function to convert string to long using strtol
def convert_string_to_long(nptr, base, endptr=None):
    nptr_bytes = nptr.encode('utf-8')
    endptr_ptr = ctypes.c_char_p()
    result = strtol(nptr_bytes, ctypes.byref(endptr_ptr), base)
    if endptr is not None:
        endptr[0] = endptr_ptr.value.decode('utf-8') if endptr_ptr.value else ''
    return result

# Assertion tests
def assert_test():
    # Test cases
    assert convert_string_to_long('123', 10) == 123
    assert convert_string_to_long('-123', 10) == -123
    assert convert_string_to_long('7B', 16) == 123
    assert convert_string_to_long('1111011', 2) == 123
    assert convert_string_to_long('0173', 8) == 123
    # Test with endptr
    endptr = ['']
    assert convert_string_to_long('123abc', 10, endptr=endptr) == 123
    assert endptr[0] == 'abc'
    # Test overflow
    try:
        convert_string_to_long('999999999999999999999999999999999999999', 10)
    except OverflowError:
        pass

if __name__ == '__main__':
    assert_test()
